from.place: proof, diagonal conormal identification: the conormal sheaf of Delta is Omega_{X/S}

title: Conormal sheaf of the diagonal and relative differentials
statement: Let f:X\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let \Delta:X\to X\times_S X be its diagonal [def-pc-base-change]. The conormal sheaf C_\Delta of this immersion is defined locally by choosing an open neighbourhood W of \Delta(X) in X\times_S X on which \Delta is a closed immersion, with ideal sheaf \mathcal I, and setting C_\Delta=\Delta^*(\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2) [def-pc-module-pullback]; this is independent of the choice of W. Define the relative Kähler differential sheaf \Omega^1_{X/S} by requiring that on every affine U=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\subseteq X mapping into an affine V=\operatorname{Spec}(R)\subseteq S, it is the sheaf associated to the A-module of Kähler differentials \Omega_{A/R} [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Then there is a canonical isomorphism C_\Delta\cong\Omega^1_{X/S}.

source.place: Tag 08S2 (conormal sheaf of the diagonal is the sheaf of relative differentials)

proof.text: Work on affine opens U=\operatorname{Spec}(A) of X and V=\operatorname{Spec}(R) of S with f(U)\subseteq V. As the statement allows any admissible W, take W to be the union of the affine opens U\times_V U=\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_R A), in which \Delta(X) is closed (Stacks 01KJ). Over U\times_V U the diagonal is the closed immersion \operatorname{Spec}(A)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_R A) induced by the surjective multiplication map, with ideal I=\ker(A\otimes_R A\to A). The affine conormal calculation [lem-weil-pbc-affine-conormal-sections] identifies \Gamma(U,C_\Delta) with I/I^2. By [lem-sc-kahler-differentials-diagonal-ideal] there is a canonical A-module isomorphism \Omega_{A/R}\cong I/I^2 [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] sending \mathrm da to the class of 1\otimes a-a\otimes 1. Hence C_\Delta|_U is canonically the sheaf associated to \Omega_{A/R}, which is the asserted affine description of \Omega^1_{X/S}.

source.place: Tag 08S2, affine calculation of the conormal of the diagonal

proof.text: The affine identifications of step 1 are compatible with restriction to smaller affine opens U'\subseteq U, V'\subseteq V, because both send \mathrm da to the class of 1\otimes a-a\otimes 1, and such elements generate. Hence they glue to a canonical morphism of \mathcal O_X-modules C_\Delta\to\Omega^1_{X/S}. It is an isomorphism because it is an isomorphism on the affine basis from step 1 (the sheaf isomorphism criterion).
